main.description: In an encrypted share whose public link is on: its keyring, for whoever has the link.

keyring.description: The keyring's keys, oldest first, sealed with AES-256-GCM (12-byte nonce first, 16-byte tag last) under HKDF-SHA256(link key, info "atdrive link key v1"), with the space's keyring info as associated data. The link key travels in the link's #fragment and never reaches a server.
